Avengers Campus Meets Cars Land & More | Pardon Our Pixie Dust
Welcome back to Pardon Our Pixie Dust ✨ Join Walt Disney Imagineering for a look at some of the projects currently in development across Disney Experiences. This episode features construction progress, attraction updates, and a behind-the-scenes look at work taking place on projects including Disney's Lakeshore Lodge, the Art of Animation expansion at Disney's Hollywood Studios, and a new pathway at Disney California Adventure.
